$comment: Every research memo, with the date a human last verified it and how fast its subject moves. Checked by scripts/check-research.mjs. A lapsed memo blocks its spec from being authored or marked done.

fast.why: AI, search, framework majors, competitor feature sets — these genuinely change quarterly, and a six-month-old memo will be confidently wrong

moderate.why: auth patterns, billing practice, vendor APIs — they move, but not quarterly

stable.why: Postgres and RLS semantics, HTTP, SQL — a year-old memo here is still broadly true

memos.area: organization context in RLS — claims vs session vars vs per-request lookup
the first row readable by a non-member — invitation tokens and the narrow-door exception
handover measurement — usability method applied to a codebase
project scaffolding and provenance — what a generated project remembers
executable documentation — running a walkthrough, and what a machine cannot check

$kinds.sourced: Cites external work. Must separate **Primary** (the vendor's own documentation, a standards body, the originating description of a pattern, or the tool's own repository) from **Secondary**, and must have at least one primary.
$kinds.measured: IS the primary evidence — we ran it and recorded what happened. Must contain a reproduction someone else can execute. A measurement with no reproduction is an anecdote.
